```{r setup, include=FALSE}

source("replace_chunk.R")

con <- dbConnect(duckdb(peter_file))

```


```{r}
### set up assessments
tbl_diag <- tbl(con,"visits_assessments") %>% 
  select(-starts_with("extract")) %>% 
  select(contains("phq"), visit_id) %>% 
  select(-starts_with("self_"), -starts_with("tbi_") , -ends_with("_care"), -starts_with("phq_")) %>% 
  collect
### set up demographics
tbl_demographics <- tbl(con,"visits_core") %>% 
  select(ptid, visit_id, csa_id, race, eth, age, gender, visit_type, visit_date, medicaid, diagnosis) %>%
  collect 
### get name of assessments
diag_name<- data.frame(colnames(tbl_diag))


tbl_diag <- tbl_diag%>%
   mutate(across(-c(visit_id), ~ as.numeric(.))) %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(starts_with("phq"), is.na))
```
### start analysis 
```{r}
#lapply(tbl_diag, unique)
```

### demographics clean up
```{r}
# set up/ data cleaning from exp_diag
demographics <- tbl_demographics %>% 
  replace_gender(gender)%>%
  replace_race(race) %>%
  replace_eth(eth) %>% 
  extract_unique_id(visit_id) %>%
  replace_medicaid(medicaid) %>%
  further_diagnosis(diagnosis) %>%
  enumerate_diagnosis(further_diag) %>% 
  fill_in(gender, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(eth, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(race, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(medicaid, new_id) %>% 
  mutate(age  = as.integer(age)) %>% 
  select(-c(ptid, csa_id, shape, shape_num))
```

### make total column
```{r}
calc_total <- tbl_diag %>% 
   mutate(phqtotal = rowSums(across(c(phqapathy, phqbad, phqconc, phqdown, phqeat, phqmotor, phqsi, phqsleep, phqtired)),  na.rm = T))
```

### add demographics
```{r}
phq <- inner_join(calc_total, demographics, by = "visit_id")%>% 
  select(-c(diagnosis, medicaid, visit_id )) 
```

```{r}
no_id <- phq %>% 
  select(-c(visit_date, new_id, num_diagnosis))
```

### demographics table
```{r}
table_1 <- tbl_summary(
  no_id,
  by = further_diag,
  type = all_dichotomous() ~ "categorical",
  statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
  label = c(list(race = "Race"), 
            list(eth = "Ethnicity"), 
            list(age = "Age"), 
            list(gender = "Gender")), 
            missing_text = "Missing Values"
) %>%  
  as_gt()
```
